sections.title: Objective
sections.body: Each round, a 4-letter draw is revealed. Propose an English word that incorporates those letters to score as many points as possible. The better the letters are positioned, the higher your score.

sections.title: Valid words
sections.body: Only words found in the English dictionary are accepted. Made-up words, proper nouns and abbreviations are rejected. A rejected submission does not count as an attempt — you can try again.

sections.title: Scoring
sections.body: A word's score is based on three components:

items.label: Used letter
items.description: Each draw letter present in your word scores 3 points. Duplicates in the draw count separately.

items.label: Order bonus
items.description: If the draw letters appear in your word in exactly the same order as the draw, you earn 3 bonus points.

items.label: Insertion
items.description: Each letter not in the draw that sits between the first and last draw-letter positions in your word (the "zone") deducts 1 point.

examples.note: 4 letters × 3 = 12, +3 order bonus, −2 insertions (L, K) → 13 pts

sections.title: Colour code
sections.body: After each attempt, the letters of your word are coloured to show their role in the score:

colors.label: Orange underlined
colors.description: Draw letter in the correct order — contributes to points and to the order bonus.

colors.label: Dimmed orange underlined
colors.description: Draw letter present in the word but out of order — scores points, no order bonus.

colors.label: Beige
colors.description: Insertion: a foreign letter inside the zone. Deducts 1 point.

colors.label: Grey
colors.description: Letter outside the zone. Does not affect the score positively or negatively.

modes.name: Daily challenge
modes.description: The same draw for all players, refreshed every day at midnight UTC. You have 3 attempts. After each attempt the best possible score is revealed — but not the word. Come back every day to improve.

modes.name: Training
modes.description: Random draws on repeat, with no limit. After each attempt the top 3 best words are revealed. Perfect for exploring strategies and improving freely.

modes.name: Solver
modes.description: Enter any draw to instantly get the 10 best possible words, ranked by score then word length.

modes.name: My stats
modes.description: View your local progress: average performance, streaks, perfect scores, and training stats — all stored on your device.
